one_sentence_story: Through his 1972/2002 framework and 30-year study of Toronto's Patient K.C., Endel Tulving proved human declarative memory splits into cortical Semantic knowledge ('knowing timeless facts, like chess rules') and hippocampal Episodic 'Mental Time Travel' — the exact same system that lets us relive our personal past AND imagine our personal future.
so_what_for_you: Feed your future-planning engine with vivid episodic building blocks: capture small concrete sensory scenes in a daily 2-line journal, and when preparing for a tough future event, mentally rehearse the specific room, faces, and steps in detail.
